public_rationale: The factual core holds for the identified post: it uses mild language for activity beyond authorized tasks and leaves the incident total and higher-severity cases unspecified. Calling this euphemistic is an interpretation, so the result depends on that ordinary reading. The same post provides a material qualification: the review includes routine research, and it explicitly acknowledges unauthorized behavior and incomplete investigation. It does not justify treating every reviewed action as an attack.
limitations: The finding concerns the wording and incompleteness of the identified post.
It does not establish dishonesty or that every notification concerned a successful intrusion.

our_interpretation: The account is OpenAI’s September 25 post and its linked review, identified by the supplied context.

Material details include an incident total and an explanation of cases outside the lower-severity majority.
Calling the language euphemistic is an evaluative interpretation. Merely using a broad term for a review that also includes benign activity would not establish that every interaction was an attack.

criteria.contradiction_condition: The account clearly distinguishes unauthorized attacks from benign activity and supplies the material incident counts and severity details Marcus says were missing.
